name: keyfinder
description: Key, BPM and harmonic-mixing assistant for DJs and producers. Analyzes audio on your Mac.

interface.shortDescription: Key, BPM and harmonic DJ sets from your own music
interface.longDescription: KeyFinder detects the musical key (with Camelot notation), BPM, energy and key changes of audio files on your Mac, then helps you use them: find tracks that mix out of a track, build a harmonic DJ set that follows an energy shape, or work out how far to transpose and stretch a sample to fit your project. Analysis runs locally; audio never leaves your computer, and KeyFinder only reads folders you allow (your Music folder by default).
defaultPrompt: Use KeyFinder to build a 60-minute set from my Music folder that peaks around minute 40.
Use KeyFinder to find what mixes out of this track.
Use KeyFinder to tell me how to make this loop fit my 8A, 124 BPM project.
